name: Loop powered Air sampling unit -Duct Detector Enclosure (includes Xpert base but not the head, also includes a 360 mm sampling tube)- Use with Xpert detector head

subcategory.name: Analogue Addressable Duct, Flame, Beam & Aspirating Detectors

family: Analogue Addressable Air Sampling Duct Detector
summary: The Intelligent Addressable Duct Smoke Detector of Context Plus provides early detection of smoke in the air moving through heating and ventilation (HVAC) ducts in commercial and industrial premises. Its purpose is to prevent the re-circulation of smoke from an area on fire to areas unaffected by the fire when used with a Context Plus Addressable Xpert Card detector.
description: The duct smoke detector is designed to operate in ducts with a width of between 300mm and 3000mm. A sampling tube of 360mm, suitable for duct widths up to 540mm, is supplied as standard. Longer sampling tubes for wider ducts may be ordered separately.
